# Family `ctrl`

<!-- Generated by cblink-gen 0.1.0 from control.yaml. Do not edit. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Name | `ctrl` |
| Version | 1 |
| C prefix | `cbl_ctrl_` |
| Family id | 0 (fixed) |

The built-in control family, present on every cblink endpoint with the
fixed family id 0.  It resolves family names to ids, lists families,
manages multicast subscriptions, answers pings and exchanges limits.

## Definitions

### `op-flags` (flags)

Operation flags reported by getfamily (the CBL_OPF_* values).

| Name | Bit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `do` | 0 | The command supports do requests. |
| `dump` | 1 | The command supports dump requests. |
| `stream` | 2 | The command opens a bidirectional stream. |
| `push` | 3 | The command opens a server-to-client stream. |
| `auth` | 4 | The command requires an authenticated peer. |

### `group-flags` (flags)

Multicast group flags (the CBL_MCF_* values).

| Name | Bit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `auth` | 4 | Subscribing requires an authenticated peer. |

## Operations

### `getfamily` (command 1)

Resolve one family by name or id (do), or list all families (dump).

- Attribute set: `ctrl`
- Do: client `cbl_ctrl_getfamily()`, server `cbl_ctrl_getfamily_doit()`
- Do request: `family-id`, `family-name`
- Do reply: `family-id`, `family-name`, `version`, `ops`, `mcast-groups`
- Dump: client `cbl_ctrl_getfamily_dump()`, server `cbl_ctrl_getfamily_dumpit()`
- Dump item: `family-id`, `family-name`, `version`, `ops`, `mcast-groups`

### `subscribe` (command 2)

Join a multicast group of a family.

- Attribute set: `ctrl`
- Do: client `cbl_ctrl_subscribe()`, server `cbl_ctrl_subscribe_doit()`
- Do request: `family-id` (required), `group-id` (required)

### `unsubscribe` (command 3)

Leave a multicast group.

- Attribute set: `ctrl`
- Do: client `cbl_ctrl_unsubscribe()`, server `cbl_ctrl_unsubscribe_doit()`
- Do request: `family-id` (required), `group-id` (required)

### `ping` (command 4)

Liveness check; the reply echoes the cookie.

- Attribute set: `ctrl`
- Do: client `cbl_ctrl_ping()`, server `cbl_ctrl_ping_doit()`
- Do request: `cookie`
- Do reply: `cookie`

### `hello` (command 5)

Exchange receive limits and implementation names.

- Attribute set: `ctrl`
- Do: client `cbl_ctrl_hello()`, server `cbl_ctrl_hello_doit()`
- Do request: `limits`, `impl`
- Do reply: `limits`, `impl`

### `newfamily` (command 6)

A family was registered.

- Attribute set: `ctrl`
- Notification on group `notify`
- Notification: `family-id`, `family-name`, `version`, `ops`, `mcast-groups`

### `delfamily` (command 7)

A family was unregistered.

- Attribute set: `ctrl`
- Notification on group `notify`
- Notification: `family-id`, `family-name`

## Multicast groups

| Name | Auth | Notifications | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notify` | no | `newfamily`, `delfamily` | Family registration changes. |
